title: Connect homeless individuals to critical resources
description:
Outreach teams and community partners are contacting people in encampments along the San Diego River to help move people experiencing homelessness out of dangerous areas and into shelters, housing or other supportive programs. 

This work is especially important with forecasters predicting a strong El Niño storm that could bring heavy rain and flooding to the region starting in the fall. This area is prone to flooding and individuals have been rescued in the past during heavy rains. 

Teams from the County of San Diego, San Diego Fire-Rescue Department, PATH San Diego, Healthcare in Action, San Diego River Park Foundation and PAVE San Diego are working throughout the 17-mile stretch of river to help connect individuals to critical resources.
